verdict.rationale: Pika is an AI video, image and audio generation platform that takes user uploads, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-use controls, or a privacy policy on model training. The pricing, features, and sign-in items do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
